name: Commerce Order Data Formatter
description: Field formatter that renders selected keys from the map-type 'data' field on Commerce orders and order items (single value or an item_list of keys), with an optional key-name label. Restricted to commerce_order and commerce_order_item; no routes, permissions, or config entities.
project_description:
Overview 

 Provides field formatter for commerce order data field that allows displaying

the value of the particular key in this field.

 Requirements 

 
 Field (Drupal core) 
 Commerce module 
 
 Installation and configuration 

 
 Install and enable the module and all dependencies. 
 On the order view display or views organize the field as your workflow requires.
